scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w src/backend && npm run lint -w src/frontend
scripts.db:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src=fs.existsSync('.env')?'.env':'.env.example'; fs.copyFileSync(src,'src/backend/.env'); console.log('Synced',src,'-> src/backend/.env');"
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:env && npm run db:generate -w src/backend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:env && npm run db:migrate -w src/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:env && npm run db:seed -w src/backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:env && npm run db:setup -w src/backend
